build_cascade_roi_heads: build a CascadeROIHeads module with multiple cascade stages for progressive box refinement in object detection
create_cascade_box_head: create cascade box heads and predictors with stage-specific IoU thresholds and box regression weights
run_cascade_forward: run the CascadeROIHeads forward pass for training with per-stage loss computation or inference with averaged scores
test_cascade_box_prediction: test the _forward_box method that iterates through cascade stages and refines proposals using previous stage predictions
review_match_and_label: review the _match_and_label_boxes method that matches proposals to ground truth using stage-specific IoU matchers
